candidates.reason: The original banner is just shrunk into a thin strip in the middle of the story canvas, so about 85% of the frame is empty gradient. The ~14px headline is far too small for a 432x768 format. The grey panel sits flat over the backdrop and the leaves are pushed to the top corners. Its one strength is a bigger, more legible bulb icon and even side margins.

The same shrunk-strip approach, with no rearrangement for the vertical format. The headline is tiny, the bulb icon is shrunk to a speck and the vertical divider lines are barely visible. The band sits arbitrarily just above centre with huge dead areas above and below.

The same shrunk banner, pushed up into the upper third, which leaves the bottom ~60% of the canvas as empty gradient and makes the balance lopsided. The headline is tiny, the icon is very small and the divider lines are faint.

The headline is slightly larger than in the others but still small for a story. The outer frame is jammed about 8px from the canvas edges, so it feels cramped sideways. The icon is undersized and the divider is a faint sliver. It is still a letterboxed banner floating in a mostly empty canvas.
